item.title: New Safety Requirements From 1 January 2026 For Anchor Handling Winches And Associated Equipment
item.description: The IMO has introduced mandatory safety requirements for anchor handling winches and the associated equipment through SOLAS Regulation II-1/3-13. The regulation enters into force on 1 January 2026. This news provides recommendations on how to plan for the new regulations.
